metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a complete Python 3.11+ CLI tool at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) that:

- Accepts all required flags: `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, `--log`
- Parses `.bib` entries (`@article` etc.), `@string`, `@preamble`, comments, concatenation with `#`, and predefined month macros
- Parses and executes `.bst` programs (top-level commands, function literals, quoted names, stack machine execution)
- Implements the required built-ins (arithmetic/comparison, stack ops, control flow, entry access, name formatting, output, string/text ops, warning emission)
- Resolves citations from `--cites` and/or `--aux` with order-preserving case-insensitive dedup
- Resolves crossrefs (including unresolved/cycle warnings)
- Produces `.bbl` output with LF line endings and 79-column wrap behavior
- Writes required structured JSON log (`--log`)
- Writes required structured JSON error object to `--output` on failure
- Uses only Python standard library

I also verified it compiles and runs from:

```bash
python /workspace/output/main.py --help
```

and performed a smoke test using `plain.bst` with generated `.bbl` and log output.
